field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF inspection confirmed Table 1 and Table 2 activity values are exactly represented in 49 final MIC records, and Supplement Fig. S13 has 13 approximate OD575 records. However, main-text activity surfaces Fig. 5 qualitative inhibition zones and Fig. 6 biofilm inhibition-rate bars are neither represented as activity records nor explicitly source-located exclusions, so body-figure activity coverage is not exhausted.

The database layer preserves the absence of authoritative DBAASP/APD6/DRAMP linked rows: five candidate groups are not promoted to source_verified, with two unresolved_record and three sequence_modified_not_normalized statuses. This preserves the fallback boundary but remains a database caution, not authoritative ingest evidence.

The common paper/packet scientific finals are byte-identical for activity, database, mechanism_ontology, and review_report, and the packet mechanism_evidence alias matches mechanism_ontology. But papers/PMC12160004/final/materials_manifest.json is a current final JSON record with stale analysis_queue_status=analysis_queued and a stale strict_boundary, while packet_manifest and the current acceptance audit report analysis_source_reviewed_accepted; this file is also absent from the packet final mirror.

The mechanism evidence classes themselves are not overpromoted, but the current mechanism final mirrors still contain 46 non-primary source_locator values such as xml_sections:sections/.../text and figure_captions:figures/.../text across claims 1, 3, and 4. These are recursive extracted-artifact locators, not primary XML/PDF/supplement coordinates.

Paper identity matches the primary source DOI/PMID/PMCID/title. A3/D-A3 plain sequence CRRWRRRRC is source-located and has nine residues; triazole variants are preserved as modified/non-normalized identities. No current final object contains both a plain one-letter sequence and sequence_length, so no sequence_length mismatch was present to repair.

Database and activity/toxicity final records use primary-style locators and preserve exact/approximate status; exact Table 1/2 activity values matched the XML cells with zero mismatches. The mechanism final records fail locator integrity because recursive extracted-artifact locators remain in source_locator fields.

Fallback DBAASP/RC2/portal release boundary is preserved: authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false and linked authoritative rows are absent. Recursive authority is not false, however, because mechanism source_locator fields still point to extracted JSON section/caption surfaces instead of primary source coordinates.

No cross-database conflict is smoothed into source_verified because no linked authoritative APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP rows are present. The current review_report correctly preserves this as a caution and keeps fallback rows out of authoritative ingest.

The staged supplement set contains one PDF, RA-015-D5RA02745D-s001.pdf. It has 17 PDF pages, text/OCR extraction, rendered visual page review, no structured tables, no unrecoverable material gaps, and source-reviewed Figure S13 digitization with uncertainty and coordinates.

Toxicity records preserve five hemolysis threshold rows (<5%, 0.9-500 μg/mL, rabbit red blood cells) and six zebrafish hatching/development rows, with reported/approximate/qualitative status retained. Exact per-bar hemolysis values are not promoted beyond the source threshold statement.

The final therefore omits body-figure activity surfaces while claiming source-reviewed publication-grade activity coverage.

cautions.summary: Authoritative DBAASP/merged linked article, assay, sequence, and literature rows are all zero. This is preserved as a caution with authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready=false; fallback machine rows remain candidate-only and excluded from RC2/portal/authoritative ingest.

Figure-derived and prose-derived non-MIC toxicity/activity observations are not exact table values: Supplement Fig. S13 OD575 rows are approximate image digitizations, hemolysis is retained as a <5% threshold, and two zebrafish rows are qualitative comparison records. The final labels these limitations, but downstream use must not treat them as exact tabulated values.
